scope: Exact-year exterior-color audit for Chevrolet Silverado HD model years 2001, 2002, 2004, 2006, and 2007. Silverado 1500 and Silverado 1500HD are outside this audit. Regular paint, SEO or fleet paint, two-tone paint, and stripe programs remain separate. The outgoing GMT880 Silverado HD Classic and the new GMT910 Silverado HD are separate 2007 evidence scopes. No color is projected across a series, body generation, market, or adjacent model year.

source_priority: Retained official General Motors Heritage vehicle information kits and appended order guides
Official Chevrolet sales brochures or specification sheets preserved by third-party document mirrors
Official General Motors fleet guides preserved by third-party document mirrors
method.source_integrity: Every retained GM Heritage PDF is identified by the SHA-256 hash and byte count in the crawler artifact ledger. Every external PDF used for a color claim was fetched in full during this audit and hashed locally; it was not added to the crawler or a GitHub release by this audit.
method.code_policy: Paint, RPO, SEO, and WA codes are recorded only when printed in the cited exact-year source. A missing code is null. No code, pair, restriction, or marketing name is carried from another year.
method.scope_policy: A unified Silverado brochure is treated as a qualified shared-lineup source unless it isolates Silverado HD applicability. Separate Silverado 2500HD and 3500 order-guide tables may support one combined palette only when both exact tables were reviewed and found identical. Silverado 1500HD is never treated as Silverado HD. The 2007 Silverado HD Classic and the new GMT910 Silverado HD are never merged.
method.absence_policy: Not located means only that the reviewed exact-year sources did not contain a governing table for that program. It is not proof that no dealer, fleet, special-order, two-tone, or stripe program existed.

validation_expectations.model_year_grain: One year object for each requested Silverado HD year: 2001, 2002, 2004, 2006, and 2007.
validation_expectations.source_reference_integrity: Every source_ref.source_id and corroborating_source_refs source_id must resolve to exactly one source object.
validation_expectations.source_artifact_integrity: Every source records a SHA-256 hash, byte count, and PDF page count; every cited page must be within the declared page count.
validation_expectations.program_uniqueness: program_id values must be unique within each model year.
validation_expectations.color_identity_uniqueness: identity_key values must be unique within each palette.
validation_expectations.scope_guard: No palette may claim Silverado 1500 or Silverado 1500HD availability. The 2007 Classic palettes may not be projected to GMT910.
validation_expectations.unresolved_year_policy: An unresolved or qualified year must contain explicit limitations and must not receive colors inferred from another year.
